explanation: The Almighty Creator who is love itself, the highest authority over all things.
The fundamental nature of God; a deep, self-sacrificing, and unconditional care for humanity.
The concept of being reborn through faith in Jesus Christ, giving each person new life in God's family.
The Holy Spirit, God's presence dwelling within believers and testifying to the truth.
The real and unadulterated foundation for faith in Jesus Christ as the Savior of the world.
A term used to describe God's purity, righteousness, and absence of sin, in contrast to darkness.
The state of sin, unbelief, and separation from God where love is absent.
To break God's laws or live outside his will; an act that separates people from him.
Jesus Christ, the one chosen by God to save humanity from sin and death.
The act in which Jesus returned in flesh to sacrifice himself for the sins of the world.
Believers who confirm the truth of God's love through their words and actions.
